st: Seeing Wilson fight Spider-Man, Vanessa flees with their son Richard, and both die in a car crash.
Kingpin's collider pulls a Vanessa from another universe to him, and she backs away from him in fear with Richard.

files.notes: Named Vanessa in dialogue and Vanessa Fisk when the collider uploads her DNA. The second step is a copy of her from another universe; what becomes of her after the collider is shut down is not shown, so Missing. No group named on screen: Independent.

add.k: A boy trapped in a car on the Williamsburg Bridge
st: Trapped in a burning car hanging off the Williamsburg Bridge, Jack wears Spider-Man's mask for courage and is pulled to safety.

files.notes: Named in dialogue (What's your name? Jack?). His father, who later lines up the cranes, is not in the app, so no tie to him. No group: Independent.

add.k: Max Dillon's dismissive boss at Oscorp
st: Smythe mocks Max Dillon's claim to have designed Oscorp's power grid, then makes him stay late on his birthday to fix a lab fault.

files.notes: Only Smythe and Mr. Smythe are said; the first name Alistair is not, but he is a version of a person the app names elsewhere, so the full name is used. Hero file: a rude boss, not a threat to the heroes.

add.k: A boy Spider-Man saves from bullies
st: Spider-Man saves Jorge from bullies, fixes his wind turbine and walks him home, and Jorge tells him his name.
Dressed as Spider-Man, Jorge stands up to the Rhino in the street until the real Spider-Man returns and sends him to his mom.

files.notes: Says his name to Spider-Man. No group: Independent.

st: In season 2, Principal Davis introduces Sinjin Devereaux and Captain Stacy as guest instructors, then reports Harry's doping to the league.

files.notes: Named in dialogue as Principal Davis (episode 18, the start of semester speech, which the transcript places in episode 18 rather than 20 as the Marvel Database has it). The first name Andrew is not said. In 22 he tells the coach the Mustangs' title is under review.

st: In season 1, Anna hears out May's money worries, then is with her at the theater when the Rhino attacks and May has a heart attack.

files.notes: Anna is said in episode 1; May says Mrs. Watson and Anna and her niece Mary Jane in episode 4, and Anna Watson is said in 5. She is also seen in episode 12. The set-up with Mary Jane is only talked about, and no shared scene with Mary Jane was confirmed, so no tie to her. No group: Independent.

st: In season 1, Dr. Kafka praises Max Dillon's progress in therapy and releases him from Ravencroft.
In season 2, Kraven bursts into her group therapy session with Max, Otto and Cletus and carries off Electro despite her pleas.

files.notes: Only Dr. Kafka is said; Ashley is not, but she is a version of the Dr. Ashley Kafka the app has in The Amazing Spider-Man 2, so that name is used (the Network name is shared with that version). Group is Ravencroft as said on screen, not the app's Ravencroft Institute, which belongs to the other universe. She also appears briefly in episode 19, possibly when John Jameson is committed, but her part there is unconfirmed.

add.k: A bookie who works the Big Sky bar
st: In season 2, bookie Blackie Gaxton points Spider-Man to Mysterio's boss, then joins the Green Goblin and hands him Mark Allan.

files.notes: Episodes 16, 23 (a phone call) and 24. In 24 the Green Goblin declares himself the new Big Man of crime and makes the bookie his first lieutenant, so his group from then is the app's The Big Man's mob; before that no group is named. Kind for the Molten Man tie is boss (Blackie holds Mark's debt and sets the terms), which a reviewer may prefer as enemy. He is not arrested after the bar fire: At large.

add.k: A cane-wielding acrobat in the Enforcers
st: In season 1, Fancy Dan fights Spider-Man with the Enforcers for the Big Man and is left webbed for police, then escapes with Hammerhead.
In season 2, the Tinkerer's suit makes him Ricochet for a gold heist, and once caught he joins a Vault breakout that Spider-Man stops.

files.notes: The surname Brito is never said; he is Fancy Dan throughout and Ricochet from episode 22. Also a cameo in 20. At the end of 22 the police close in on the crashed getaway car, and in 25 he is a Vault inmate.

add.k: Norman Osborn's personal assistant at Oscorp
st: In season 2, Menken runs Norman's secret auction of the Rhino armor specs, then is framed as the Green Goblin and stays silent when accused.

files.notes: Named by a security system (Menken, comma, Donald) and in dialogue. Raft file for running the criminal auction for Norman. His Network name is the same as the app's Amazing Spider-Man 2 Menken; ties are meant for this version. Left behind in his apartment, not arrested: At large.

st: In season 1, quarterback Flash bullies Peter and loses Liz over him, then snaps Peter out of his dark mood and helps save Gwen.
In season 2, Flash wins state but wrecks his knee, loses Liz to Peter, then exposes Harry's doping and starts dating Sha Shan.

files.notes: Shares his Network name with the app's Amazing Spider-Man Flash Thompson; ties are meant for this version. The injury in 15 needs surgery and his knee still bothers him in 23. Kenny Kong and Sha Shan are not in the app, so no ties to them.

st: In season 1, Bugle reporter Foswell waves off the rumor that L. Thompson Lincoln is the Big Man and covers John Jameson's landing.
In season 2, Foswell, secretly the informant Patch, plants a bug on Menken at the Rhino armor auction and works a gang summit as a waiter.

files.notes: Only Foswell and Mr. Foswell are said; Frederick is not. Patch first appears in 16 as a seemingly separate lowlife and is shown to be Foswell in 21. The Marvel Database says he writes the story exposing Tombstone, but that is uncited and not in the transcript, so it is left out.

add.k: A popular Midtown High student, Kenny's girlfriend
st: In season 1, Glory dumps Kenny over a prank and goes to the fall formal with Harry, but takes Kenny back at the dance.
In season 2, Glory wins a part in the school play with Kenny and plays the fairy Cobweb on opening night.

files.notes: Glory is said in 5 and Glory Grant in 6. Seen in many other episodes with few lines. Kenny Kong is not in the app, so no tie to him.

add.k: An NYPD patrol officer wary of Spider-Man
st: In season 1, Officer DeWolff and her partner Carter are called into the fight when the Sinister Six attack Manhattan.
In season 2, DeWolff takes Flash and Harry on a police ride-along with Carter and argues that Spider-Man goes too far.

files.notes: Only DeWolff is said; Jean is not, but she is a version of a person the app names elsewhere. Seen in many episodes, with lines only in 22, where her ride-along pair is Flash and Harry (Peter rides with Sally in another car). Stan Carter is not in the app, so no tie to him.

k: An Air Force colonel and astronaut, Jonah's son
st: In season 1, Air Force Colonel John Jameson helps Spider-Man find the Goblin's bomb at a gala, then lands his meteor-damaged shuttle.
In season 2, alien spores make him superstrong, and as Colonel Jupiter he fights Spider-Man until a power surge cures him and unhinges him.

files.notes: Air Force Colonel is said on screen; U.S. Air Force follows the app's spelling for that service. At the end of 19 he is shut away in a psychiatric hospital, raving for his power, beside Electro; Imprisoned is used for that commitment, and a reviewer may prefer another status. Hero file: he fights Spider-Man only while maddened by the spores.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Vanessa sees her husband Wilson fighting Spider-Man and flees with their son Richard, and both die in a car crash. Wilson builds his collider to bring them back, but the Vanessa it pulls in from another universe backs away from him in fear.
stages.whoA: Wilson, her husband, the Kingpin
stages.whoB: Vanessa, his late wife

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man finds Jack trapped in a burning car hanging from the Williamsburg Bridge. He takes off his mask, lends it to Jack for courage and webs him to safety as the car falls.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who pulls him from a falling car
stages.whoB: Jack, the boy he saves on the bridge

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Smythe sneers at Max Dillon when he says he designed Oscorp's power grid. On Max's birthday he orders him to stay late and fix a fault in the lab, where Max falls into the eel tanks.
stages.whoA: Max Dillon, the electrician he belittles
stages.whoB: Smythe, his dismissive boss at Oscorp

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Spider-Man chases off bullies, fixes Jorge's wind turbine and walks him home. Later Jorge faces the Rhino in a Spider-Man costume, and the real Spider-Man returns, thanks him and sends him to his mom.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, his hero, who saves him twice
stages.whoB: Jorge, the brave boy he walks home

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Jorge, in his Spider-Man costume, steps in front of the Rhino as he rampages down the street. The Rhino taunts the little boy until Spider-Man swings in.
stages.whoA: The Rhino, the armored man he stands up to
stages.whoB: A little boy in a Spider-Man costume

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Principal Davis tells Midtown's students who their guest instructors are. After Harry's doping comes to light, Davis reports it to the league, and the Mustangs' state title goes under review.
stages.whoA: Harry, the student whose doping he reports
stages.whoB: Principal Davis, who reports him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash owns up that he told on Harry's doping, and Principal Davis reports it to the league. The Mustangs' title that Flash helped win goes under review.
stages.whoA: Flash, the quarterback who tells him the truth
stages.whoB: Principal Davis, his principal

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Anna is May's confidante as May admits the Parkers are almost out of money. When the Rhino attacks outside their theater, Anna is beside May as she has a heart attack.
stages.whoA: May Parker, her closest friend
stages.whoB: Anna, her best friend

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Anna is the friend May visits and the aunt of the girl May wants Peter to meet. After May collapses, Anna keeps calling the Parker house to reach Peter.
stages.whoA: Peter, May's nephew
stages.whoB: Anna, Aunt May's friend

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Kafka praises Max Dillon's progress and lets him leave Ravencroft. Later Max is back in her group therapy when Kraven breaks in to free him, and he ignores her pleas to stay.
stages.whoA: Max Dillon, her patient, who calls himself Electro
stages.whoB: Dr. Kafka, his therapist at Ravencroft

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto Octavius sits in Dr. Kafka's group therapy, where she praises his progress and he rejects the name Doctor Octopus. Kraven bursts in to free him too, but Otto cowers and is left behind.
stages.whoA: Otto Octavius, a patient in her group
stages.whoB: Dr. Kafka, his therapist at Ravencroft

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kraven bursts into Dr. Kafka's group therapy session to free her patients for the Master Planner. He carries off Electro while she begs Max not to go.
stages.whoA: Kraven, who breaks into her session
stages.whoB: The therapist whose session he breaks up

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man leans on Blackie for the stolen tech Mysterio was moving, and Blackie admits Mysterio fronts for a big boss. Later Spider-Man fights the Molten Man that Blackie helped create in the burning Big Sky bar.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who squeezes him for tips
stages.whoB: Blackie Gaxton, a bookie he leans on

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Green Goblin storms the Big Sky bar and declares himself the new Big Man of crime. Blackie backs the winner and becomes his first lieutenant, bringing him Mark Allan for an experiment.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, his new boss
stages.whoB: Blackie, his first lieutenant

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Mark Allan owes his bookie Blackie money he cannot pay. Blackie offers him a way out through a secret procedure, and Mark becomes the Molten Man and sets the Big Sky bar on fire.
stages.whoA: Mark Allan, a gambler deep in his debt
stages.whoB: Blackie, the bookie he owes

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Fancy Dan and the Enforcers try to squash Spider-Man for the Big Man, and Spider-Man leaves him webbed for police. He returns as Ricochet for a gold heist and later fights Spider-Man in the Vault breakout.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who keeps beating the Enforcers
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, an Enforcer later called Ricochet

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Fancy Dan, Ox and Montana are the Enforcers. Montana becomes the Shocker and leads them as the new Enforcers on a gold heist, and the three end up in the Vault together.
stages.whoA: Montana, his fellow Enforcer, the Shocker
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, his fellow Enforcer

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Hammerhead brings the Enforcers to the Big Man and gives them their orders. He takes Fancy Dan and Ox with him in the breakout while Montana stays behind.
stages.whoA: Hammerhead, who gives the Enforcers orders
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, one of his Enforcers

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Big Man hires the Enforcers to squash Spider-Man after seeing him on video. Fancy Dan's crew later robs gold for him as the new Enforcers.
stages.whoA: The Big Man, the crime boss they work for
stages.whoB: Fancy Dan, one of his Enforcers

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Tinkerer builds Fancy Dan a kinetic energy suit and tunes it so he can bounce faster as Ricochet.
stages.whoA: The Tinkerer, who builds his Ricochet suit
stages.whoB: Ricochet, who tests his suit

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Menken is Norman's assistant and runs the Rhino armor auction for him, selling Kingsley a fake drive. When Norman needs a scapegoat, he makes Menken look like the Green Goblin.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, his boss
stages.whoB: Menken, his personal assistant

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man is told Menken is the Green Goblin and confronts him in his new apartment. Menken says he has no response, and the real Goblin springs his trap.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who accuses him of being the Goblin
stages.whoB: Menken, the man he thinks is the Goblin

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Patch plants a bug on Menken as he runs the secret Rhino armor auction. Foswell and Peter listen in as the bidding climbs to half a billion dollars.
stages.whoA: Menken, the auctioneer he bugs
stages.whoB: Patch, who bugs him at the auction

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Foswell tells Peter what he knows about the Big Man rumors. Later Peter joins his gang war story, and they listen in on the Rhino armor auction through Patch's bug.
stages.whoA: Peter, a young Bugle photographer
stages.whoB: Mr. Foswell, a Bugle reporter

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Jameson barks orders at Foswell and sends him to cover John's shuttle landing. He calls Foswell lazy and refuses to fund his gang war story until Peter's photos change his mind.
stages.whoA: Jameson, his editor
stages.whoB: Foswell, one of his reporters

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Fed up with Kenny's prank, Glory has Harry take her home and goes to the fall formal as his date. At the dance she takes Kenny back, leaving Harry on his own.
stages.whoA: Harry, her date to the fall formal
stages.whoB: Glory, his date who goes back to Kenny

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Glory and Sally are part of Midtown's popular crowd. At the fall formal Sally scolds Glory for dumping the guy with the limo before the dance was over.
stages.whoA: Sally, a friend in the popular crowd
stages.whoB: Glory, a friend in the popular crowd

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash bullies Peter but later talks him out of his dark mood. They fight over Liz, who leaves Flash for Peter, yet Flash invites Peter to his party and asks him for help winning Sha Shan.
stages.whoA: Peter, the geek he bullies and comes to like
stages.whoB: Flash, the quarterback who bullies him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Liz is Flash's girlfriend until she dumps him for being jealous of Peter. After his injury he tries to win her back, but she chooses Peter.
stages.whoA: Liz, his girlfriend who leaves him
stages.whoB: Flash, her jealous ex-boyfriend

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash and Harry play together on the Mustangs and win state. When Harry's doping comes out, Flash is the one who reports it, saying a title only counts if it is won fair.
stages.whoA: Harry, his teammate who dopes
stages.whoB: Flash, the teammate who reports him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash is smitten with Mary Jane at the fall formal, where they are crowned king and queen. At the parade they rush over together to help save Gwen.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, the girl he keeps hitting on
stages.whoB: Flash, who keeps hitting on her

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash rides along with DeWolff and Carter and insists Spider-Man handles the real threats. DeWolff answers that Spider-Man goes too far when he takes the law into his own hands, and the patrol leads them to a real bank robbery.
stages.whoA: Flash, a student on her ride-along
stages.whoB: Officer DeWolff, his ride-along officer

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Harry is paired with Flash for a ride-along with DeWolff and Carter. The patrol takes them to a real bank robbery by the new Enforcers.
stages.whoA: Harry, a student on her ride-along
stages.whoB: Officer DeWolff, his ride-along officer

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Jonah proudly shows off his son John before his shuttle mission and frets through the landing. When spores give John powers, Jonah talks him into fighting Spider-Man as Colonel Jupiter and blames Spider-Man for what follows.
stages.whoA: Pop, his proud father
stages.whoB: John, his astronaut son

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: John helps Spider-Man find the Goblin's bomb in a chandelier. Later, maddened by spores as Colonel Jupiter, he fights Spider-Man, who cures him with a power surge.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who helps him and later cures him
stages.whoB: John Jameson, who helps him and then fights him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Green Goblin crashes the gala John attends with his father. John charges one of his men and is shot down.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, who crashes his gala
stages.whoB: An astronaut at the gala he crashes

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Connors studies the spores in John's body and builds the suit he wears as Colonel Jupiter. After the fight Connors finds the spores gone.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, who treats him
stages.whoB: Colonel Jameson, his patient

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Captain Stacy calls Carter and DeWolff to his side when the Sinister Six attack Manhattan. Later he puts Flash and Harry in their car for the ride-along, and the patrol brings them to the bank robbery he is working.
stages.whoA: Captain Stacy, her commanding officer
stages.whoB: Officer DeWolff, one of his officers

changes.was: In season 1, Anna hears out May's money worries, then is with her at the movies when the Rhino attacks and May has a heart attack.
changes.now: In season 1, Anna hears out May's money worries, then is with her at the theater when the Rhino attacks and May has a heart attack.
changes.why: May and Anna have theater tickets for a show in Times Square ('Go! Through the theater!', 'they're canceling tonight's show'), not a movie.

changes.was: In season 1, Bugle reporter Foswell tells Peter the rumor that L. Thompson Lincoln is the Big Man and covers John Jameson's landing.
changes.now: In season 1, Bugle reporter Foswell waves off the rumor that L. Thompson Lincoln is the Big Man and covers John Jameson's landing.
changes.why: Foswell tells Peter the Lincoln rumor is false ('I checked it out... if there is a Big Man out there, his name's not Lincoln'); he does not pass it on as a lead.

changes.was: Anna is May's confidante as May admits the Parkers are almost out of money. When the Rhino attacks outside their movie theater, Anna is beside May as she has a heart attack.
changes.now: Anna is May's confidante as May admits the Parkers are almost out of money. When the Rhino attacks outside their theater, Anna is beside May as she has a heart attack.
changes.why: The attack happens outside a Times Square theater where they have show tickets, not a movie theater.
Missing important tie: Captain Stacy commands her in the Sinister Six fight ('Carter, Dewolff, with me.') and assigns Flash and Harry to her car for the ride-along he runs.
